content.text: Chapters X–XXI follow Cameron and companions through the Canadian West during growing Indigenous unrest and the 1885 Rebellion. Raven rescues Moira from a runaway wagon; neighbors build the Camerons a house; Mandy nurses a sick Piegan boy; Cameron investigates conspirators in Sun Dance Canyon, arrests Eagle Feather, and later captures Sioux leader Copperhead. Raven, an outlaw but secretly loyal, saves stolen cattle and dies protecting Cameron, Moira, and the Queen. Cameron escapes captivity with Jerry and patrols the Ghost River region while Crowfoot’s loyalty helps prevent wider war. After rebellion ends, Cameron and Moira’s family prosper, and Dr. Martin finally declares his love for Moira. The appended articles discuss fireproof initiation rites, American building stones, farming, lime kilns, apple-jelly manufacture, grape bags, solar heat, surveying meridians, pheasants, trees, and American woods. A Shire-horse manual emphasizes sound mares, superior sires, and responsible breeding.
